description:
Hello from Space Spark! We are a team of researchers and tech enthusiasts with deep interests in precision agriculture, climate-smart solutions, and bio-environmental systems. By taking on "Adapting Farms with NASA Data," we aim to empower agricultural communities to adapt to shifting climate patterns using real-time satellite insights.
We bring strong skills in scientific research, system architecture, Python, and project management. If you want a collaborative team that values both technical !
